metadata.label: negative
metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: Photorealistic close-up of a clear glass mug filled with vigorously boiling water, showing large bubbles rising to the surface. Floating directly on top of the boiling liquid is a thick, solid sheet of clear ice that remains perfectly intact and unfrozen. High detail, studio lighting, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: Boiling water at 100C cannot sustain a solid ice sheet on its surface, as the extreme heat would instantly melt it.
